standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Standard scheme fact: flat pullback is exact; jointly surjective flat families reflect injective/surjective maps of modules (checked at stalks)

core_obligations: Presentation step: X = [U/R] with QCoh(X) = QCoh(U,R,s,t,c); phi is mono/epi/iso iff its restriction to U_etale is so (cited groupoid abelian lemma) (proof lines 397-410).

Scheme step: the coverings W_{i,j} -> V x_X U_i give jointly surjective flat g_{i,j}: W_{i,j} -> U and h_{i,j}: W_{i,j} -> U_i; pullback compatibilities of the restrictions are cited; exactness of flat pullback plus the reflection property for jointly surjective flat families yields the equivalence chain (proof lines 413-438).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to the groupoid cover where exactness is detected.
Connect the cover restrictions through flat pullback reflection.
difficulty_reason: Reduction to a groupoid presentation where exactness is detected on the cover (Groupoids in Spaces abelian lemma), followed by a scheme-level argument: the etale coverings of the fibre products give jointly surjective flat morphisms g_{i,j} and h_{i,j}; flat pullback of qc modules is exact and a jointly surjective flat family reflects injective/surjective/bijective maps (exactness at stalks), giving the three-way equivalence.
